title: Changing a part number is recorded at both locations with Changed at
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), a role that has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Create & Edit' and 'Delete'.
  • You can also switch to a second location, {Location-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RENUM Loc).
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RENUM-01), with description {Description-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL RENUM PART), is stocked at both {Location-A} and {Location-B} on the same Part Library entry.
  • The new part number to type is {Number-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-RENUM-01B).
custom_steps:
1. At {Location-A} open {Part-A}, change Part Number to {Number-A} and click Save.
  2. Open {Part-A}'s Part History at {Location-A}.
  3. Switch to {Location-B} and open the same part's Part History there.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: Before the save the dialog shows "This also changes the part number at 1 other location." under the field, and the save succeeds.
  • Step 2: The newest entry reads "Part number updated | Original number: {Part-A} | New number: {Number-A}" with nothing after it.
  • Step 3: The newest entry reads "Part number updated | Original number: {Part-A} | New number: {Number-A} | Changed at: {Location-A}", naming the location where the change was made.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R23, S10-R25, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 2.4 (Part History at Heavy Duty) and 2.6 (Part History at Lethbridge), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part number changed on a part other locations stock): “"This also changes the part number at {n} other locations." ("1 other location." for one) | Text under the field while it differs”
  • S10-R23: “A changed part number writes "Part number updated | Original number: {old} | New number: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S10-R25: “On the entries written at the other locations, the line ends with "| Changed at: {location}", naming the location where the change was made.”
